scope: Static PE/Capstone analysis only; no IDA session, game execution, real account reads or network traffic.

AssetPath.value_contract: 40 lowercase hexadecimal resource-version directory; native code prepends its fixed CDN origin

GameInfo.shape: two parallel columns: string names and int32/string integer values

MBL.shape: CMenuBlock dynamic table; empty container clears menu blocks

heartbeat.processing: 0x643b60 checks completion bit, parses response with request object+0x38 vtable+0x14, handles groups and sets global stage to 2; later invokes callback 0x698490.
heartbeat.local_policy_evidence: Maintenance=0 and LimitType=0 bypass the maintenance/limit branches in 0x698490/0x6693c0. Major/Minor are stored but not checked by the heartbeat callback 0x698490.

quest_record.response_encoding: plain ALContainer XML; no Snappy or XOR in this path
quest_record.shape: flat DA columns; matching positions are rows. Semantic column names also work because rename only acts if alias exists.
quest_record.post_load: 0xAFF860 imports table; 0x654be0 rebuilds QuestID -> row index map.
quest_record.success: post-import row_count != 0 OR (GameParam.Money == 0 AND GameParam.Experience == 0). Otherwise 0x65bc00 retries indefinitely.
quest_record.missing_data: With local Money=1000, an empty table never completes. Do not fabricate QuestID; source rows must use verified master IDs or explicit existing local quest records.

additional_startup_endpoint.response_shape: flat two parallel columns. String column supplies names and INT column supplies values; both-string columns do not work for this parser.
additional_startup_endpoint.key_evidence: 0x643830 reads 0x400 bytes and passes plaintext to 0x61d750. 0x644aa0 uses ALContainer type 3 as string key and type 1 as integer value; it does not compare column names.
additional_startup_endpoint.shared_base: 0x6433ee uses E6E874; same existing client base patch applies.

version_gate.comparison: unsigned, checked independently after maintenance/limit checks

asset_path_correction.meaning: 40-character public resource-version directory, not a complete base URL
